title: One counter carry step
statement: Let $x$, $u$, and $b$ be finite Boolean lists, and let $p$ be an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions for input $x$. Starting in state $1$ with the input head at $p$, the work-tape head at position $|u|$, tape contents given by the counter tape for $u$ concatenated with $b$, and empty output, one counter-machine step yields the following configuration: if the first entry of $b$ is true, the state remains $1$, the work-tape head moves to $|u|+1$, and the tape becomes the counter tape for $u$ followed by false and then the tail of $b$; otherwise the state becomes $2$, the work-tape head moves to $|u|-1$, and the tape becomes the counter tape for $u$ followed by true and then the tail of $b$. In both cases the input head remains at $p$ and the output remains empty.
